metadata.title: Get-ExpiredWebhook
metadata.description: This runbook gets all webhooks within in your resource group and checks if the webhook will expire within the defined time range (days). The runbook will check if the expiration date is within the date from now + days. If so it will send a mail out to the address specified. The runbook uses an Automation Credential to authenticate the user sending the email.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$AutomationCredentialAssetName' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
